# USA Asians Articles

> A comprehensive archive of interviews, articles, and cultural commentary documenting Asian-American experiences in entertainment, civil rights, and representation.

This site features in-depth interviews with prominent Asian-American artists, performers, and cultural figures, alongside critical articles examining representation, stereotypes, and historical events affecting Asian-American communities. The collection spans entertainment industry profiles, cultural analysis, and documentation of important civil rights cases and social issues.

## Key Topics

- Asian-American representation
- Entertainment industry
- Civil rights
- Cultural commentary
- Asian-American artists
- Stereotypes and media
- Featured performers
- Celebrity interviews
- Cultural identity
- Hate crimes and violence
- Model minority myth
- Hollywood discrimination
- Asian-American cinema
- Biography
- Cultural analysis

## Critical Essays & Cultural Analysis

- [The Model Minority Awakened (Murder of Vincent Chin) Pt 1](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/articles-vincentchin.html): Historical analysis of Vincent Chin murder and model minority myth
- [ARTICLE: The Circuit of Culture of Asian Mail-Order Brides by Christine Ho](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/articles-mailorder-bride.html): Cultural analysis of Asian mail-order bride phenomenon and gender studies
- [COMMENTARY - Creative Gold Beyond the Yellow Ceiling](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/yellow-ceiling.html): Commentary on Hollywood casting discrimination and Asian-American representation
- [ARTICLE: Eerily Similar (A Tale of a Hate Crime) by Gode Davis](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/articles-eerily-similar.html): Article examining parallels in Asian-American hate crimes and violence
- [ARTICLE: The Murder of Cau Tran Written by Tudo Nguyen](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/articles-cau-tran.html): Article on the Cau Tran murder case and Asian-American violence
- [ARTICLE: When Artwork Hurts Feelings and What to Do About It](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/artwork.html): Article on racist imagery and artwork's cultural impact

## Filmmaker & Media Producer Interviews

- [INTERVIEW: Jeff Adachi - Producer of the film - SLANTED EYES](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/slanted-screen.html): Interview with filmmaker Jeff Adachi on Asian stereotypes in media
- [INTERVIEW: Sheridan Prasso - Writer of the book "The Asian Mystique"](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/michael-kang.html): Interview with author Sheridan Prasso on Asian media representation
- [INTERVIEW: The Creators/Actors Behind the Dairy Queen Commercial](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/dairy-queen.html): Interview with creators and actors behind Dairy Queen commercial

## Theater & Musical Performance Interviews

- [Interview with Lea Salonga](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/lea-salonga.html): Interview with Tony Award-winning actress and singer Lea Salonga
- [INTERVIEW: Telly Leung Talks About Being in Rent and His Solo Career](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/telly-leung.html): Interview with musical theater actor Telly Leung on Rent and solo work
- [Interview with Philip Kan Gotanda (Chronicler of the Asian American Experience)](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/philip-kan-gotanda.html): Interview with playwright Philip Kan Gotanda on Asian-American representation
- [INTERVIEW: David Henry Hwang Talking About His Family Background](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/davidhenryhwang.html): Interview with acclaimed playwright David Henry Hwang on family and heritage

## Performing Arts & Entertainment Interviews

- [INTERVIEW: Lalaine](https://usasians-articles.tripod.com/lalaine.html): Interview with Lizzie McGuire actress Lalaine

## Classical Music & Arts Interviews
